fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) share price plummeted 28.9% intraday following weak Q4 guidance, though Q3 revenue of $16.51 billion (up 20.9% year-over-year) and adjusted EPS of $0.52 exceeded expectations, Q4 guidance fell well short of market expectations.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q4 revenue guidance of $15.5 billion (13% below consensus of $17.02 billion) and adjusted EPS of $0.25 (43% below consensus of $0.44) warned that PC market weakness will persist through H1 2027.
fields.summary_ko.2: Intel share price is up 61.6% since the start of the year but currently trades at $63.63, down 54.9% from the 52-week high of $140.94 (June 2026), and has not been selected despite the broad investment trend in massive AI infrastructure.
